mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ntf_info ( internal_user_id, installation_id, device_token, device_id, brd_cd, platform_type, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{entity.internalUserId}, #{entity.installationId}::uuid, #{entity.deviceToken}, #{entity.deviceId}, #{entity.brdCd}, #{entity.platformType}, #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (internal_user_id, installation_id) DO UPDATE SET device_token = EXCLUDED.device_token, device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id, brd_cd = EXCLUDED.brd_cd, platform_type = EXCLUDED.platform_type, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE ntf_info SET device_token = #{entity.deviceToken}, device_id = #{entity.deviceId}, brd_cd = #{entity.brdCd}, platform_type = #{entity.platformType}, updated_at = #{entity.updatedAt} WHERE internal_user_id = #{entity.internalUserId} AND installation_id = #{entity.installationId}::uuid
